text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Happy Meek and Trainer Kiryuin want to train with us, their role models and rivals, for our mutual benefit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Specifically, Happy Meek has taken it upon herself to issue a challenge to us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as she says, I do believe it would be beneficial for <chrname> too. We eagerly agree to take them on!
